outcome: very low birth weight or extremely low birth weight (in at least one twin)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 583 women with subsequent twin pregnancies who delivered between 2016 and 2023.
finding: Women with an inter-pregnancy interval of 36-59 months had a lower risk of very low birth weight or extremely low birth weight in at least one twin compared to those with an IPI < 24 months.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery history was identified as an unmodifiable risk factor related to adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in subsequent twin pregnancies.
